The third one is the bear trap unlocked at Level 4. Unlike the previous two traps, it can only hit a single enemy, but deals more damage. Upon contact, it stuns the enemy hit for 3 seconds. The spike traps are good for early-game, the landmines are good for crowds, and the bear traps are good for stalling. If you leak enemies a lot, you should just bring a much better tower to not leak enemies in the first place.
